raw_response: {"command": "find /work -name node_modules -prune -o -name .git -prune -o -type f -name '*.*' -print | grep -E '[.](css|ts|tsx|js|jsx|scss|vue|html)$' | xargs grep -liE 'z-index|zIndex' | head -50"}
{"command": "cd /work/apps && timeout 20 grep -rnE 'z-index|zIndex' . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | grep -iE 'backdrop|login|map|control' | head -40"}
{"command": "cd /work && ls apps && timeout 25 grep -rliE 'backdrop|z-?index' apps 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -40"}
{"command": "cd /work/apps && ls canvas passenger-ops && timeout 20 find canvas passenger-ops -maxdepth 3 -name node_modules -prune -o -type d -print | head -60"}
{"command": "cd /work/apps/canvas/src && timeout 20 grep -rnE 'z-index|zIndex|backdrop' styles ops screens 2>/dev/null | head -60"}
{"command": "cd /work/apps/canvas/src && grep -nE 'z-index|--z|--layer' styles/tokens.css | head -30; sed -n 380,396p styles/landing.css; grep -rn 'ops-map-controls' . | head"}

{"command": "cd /work/apps/canvas/src && sed -i '0,/--bg-primary: #0a0f1a;/s//--z-map-controls: 9; --z-modal: 50; --bg-primary: #0a0f1a;/' styles/tokens.css && sed -i '/^.auth-backdrop {/,/^}/s/z-index: 1;/z-index: var(--z-modal);/' styles/landing.css && sed -i '86s/z-index: 9;/z-index: var(--z-map-controls);/' ops/ops.css && grep -n 'z-map-controls' styles/tokens.css ops/ops.css && grep -n 'z-modal' styles/tokens.css styles/landing.css"}

{"command": "cd /work/apps/canvas/src && grep -c 'z-modal' styles/tokens.css; sed -i '0,/^  --bg-primary: #0a0f1a;/s//  --z-map-controls: 9;\n  --z-modal: 50;\n  --bg-primary: #0a0f1a;/' styles/tokens.css; grep -nE 'z-map-controls|z-modal' styles/tokens.css"}

{"command": "cd /work/apps/canvas/src && awk '!d && /^  --bg-primary: #0a0f1a;/ {print \"  --z-map-controls: 9;\"; print \"  --z-modal: 50;\"; d=1} {print}' styles/tokens.css > /tmp/t.css && cp /tmp/t.css styles/tokens.css && grep -nE 'z-map-controls|z-modal' styles/tokens.css ops/ops.css styles/landing.css"}
